name: listen. Audiobook Player
subtitle: Your books, at your own pace
description:
listen. is a personal audiobook player for your own DRM-free books. Import audio files, folders and ZIP archives, organize your library, and keep listening across your devices with iCloud.

Find your place with chapters, bookmarks and notes. Adjust playback speed, set your preferred skip intervals, use smart rewind after a pause, or fall asleep with a custom timer. An explicit play queue and nested folders help keep a large library organized.

Bring in books from Files, iCloud Drive, direct HTTPS downloads, a temporary local browser transfer, or your own Audiobookshelf or Jellyfin server. Optional metadata matching adds book information and covers. MP3 tracks can be combined into an M4B audiobook while retaining the imported originals.

Connect Goodreads to view Want to Read, Currently Reading and Read shelves in a session independent of Safari, or import a Goodreads CSV export. Goodreads authentication and refresh availability depend on Goodreads.

iCloud features require a signed-in Apple account. The app does not include an audiobook catalogue or supply audiobook downloads.
reviewNotes: Core playback and file imports do not require an account. Goodreads, iCloud and media-server integrations are optional and use the user's own accounts. The Mac App Store edition is a self-contained Mac Catalyst audiobook player and does not install or depend on the separate desktop torrent/catalog application. Goodreads webpage resources are restricted to providers/authentication CAPTCHA; website scripts are disabled during shelf refresh. The privacy label includes optional Goodreads/Amazon account and website data. No ad SDK or IDFA access is included. Screenshots show the app with an original short sample recording; no audiobook catalogue or downloads are supplied.
